title: FloodGuard Private Flood Policy: Loss Settlement and Basement Terms by Tier
content:
This schedule of the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy sets, tier by tier, the loss settlement basis for building and contents, the share of replacement cost a building limit must reach for replacement-cost settlement, what is covered in a basement, the advance payable before a proof of loss, and the proof-of-loss period.

## Settlement basis

| Tier | Building settlement (primary residence insured to the required share) | Required building limit, as a share of the building's replacement cost | Contents settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | Not applicable | 0% | Actual cash value |
| FloodGuard Essential | Actual cash value | 80% | Actual cash value |
| FloodGuard Standard | Replacement cost | 80% | Actual cash value |
| FloodGuard Plus | Replacement cost | 80% | Replacement cost |
| FloodGuard Premier | Replacement cost | 80% | Replacement cost |
| FloodGuard High Value | Replacement cost | 80% | Replacement cost |

The building settlement column states the basis for a primary residence whose building limit reaches the required share of the building's replacement cost. The required share is 0% on FloodGuard Contents Only, where no building is insured.

## Basement terms

| Tier | Basement contents covered beyond washers, dryers, freezers and their contents | Finished basement walls, floors and ceilings covered | Most paid for covered basement contents (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | No | No | 0 |
| FloodGuard Essential | No | No | 0 |
| FloodGuard Standard | No | No | 0 |
| FloodGuard Plus | No | No | 0 |
| FloodGuard Premier | Yes | Yes | 25000 |
| FloodGuard High Value | Yes | Yes | 50000 |

A basement contents cap of 0 means that only the appliances are covered in the basement on that tier.

## Advance and proof of loss

| Tier | Advance before the proof of loss, as a share of the adjuster's undisputed building estimate | Proof-of-loss period (calendar days from the date of loss) |
|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 0% (no advance) | 60 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 0% (no advance) | 60 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 25% | 60 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 25% | 90 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 50% | 90 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 50% | 90 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical building with a replacement cost of 300,000 USD reaches the required 80% share with a building limit of 240,000 USD or more; a limit of 239,000 USD falls short of it.
- A hypothetical adjuster's undisputed building estimate of 40,000 USD supports an advance of 10,000 USD on FloodGuard Standard or Plus (25%) and 20,000 USD on FloodGuard Premier or High Value (50%); FloodGuard Contents Only and Essential pay no advance.
